disorder: W*uniform[-1/2,1/2] scalar onsite in sample only
electrostatics: First-order equilibrium-injectivity local neutrality; no full Poisson solve
clean: One distinct clean calculation per model; replicated array entries only unify dimensions
spread: sample standard deviation ddof=1, not SEM
normalized_denominator: Corresponding clean four-terminal kappa at identical tau
clean_and_overlap_checks: Exact array equality for all available quantities at QSH W=0 and W=0.1

gap_bound.meaning: Each shown W obeys W/2 < clean bulk spectral distance at EF; does not imply a protected nonlinear coefficient

release_portability.note: File paths relocated for the public package. Numeric datasets and historical numerical/source hashes are unchanged. historical_sources entries document unavailable prior generators, not runtime dependencies.
